summary.en: The commercial workhorse: a large case in a pocket in the door edge, with a huge function catalogue (passage, entry, classroom, storeroom, exit). Retrofit means understanding the function, not just the dimensions.
summary.zh: 商用主力：门锁边的大锁体，功能目录极其庞大（通道、入户、教室、库房、逃生）。改造的关键是理解功能，而不只是尺寸。

en: Large mortise case, typically 4 in or 4-3/4 in tall
Cylinder mounted separately in the case
Trim (lever or knob) on both faces
zh: 大型锁体，常见高度 4 英寸或 4-3/4 英寸
两侧饰件（把手或球形把手）
按功能不同配置的凸轮与锁定机构

measurements.typical: Case height 4 in (102 mm) or 4-3/4 in (121 mm)

how.en: Remove the case and measure the pocket.
Door edge to the cylinder centre.

measurements.typical: 1-3/4 in (45 mm) typical for commercial doors
Function-dependent; record the actual spindle-to-cylinder value from the case

how.en: With the trim off, measure the case from the spindle centre to the cylinder centre.
how.zh: 拆下饰件后，在锁体上量方轴中心到锁芯中心。

notes.en: On a door with panic hardware or an access-control reader, the retrofit must not defeat either. Where a reader already exists, an electrified lock (A156.25) is usually a better path than a battery motor.
notes.zh: 在带逃生推杆或门禁读卡器的门上，改造不得使两者失效。若已有读卡器，采用电动化锁具（A156.25）通常比电池电机更合适。

en.q: How many cycles does a mortise lock survive?
en.a: Allegion lists 1,000,000 for A156.13 Grade 1 and 800,000 for Grades 2 and 3 — an unusual case where the lower grades share a number.

zh.q: 插芯锁组能承受多少次循环？
zh.a: Allegion 给出 A156.13 Grade 1 为 1,000,000 次，Grade 2 与 3 均为 800,000 次——这是少见的低等级数值相同的情况。
